Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Eternal Rest Monuments, LLC specializes in the sale and installation of high-quality granite and marble monuments and tombstones. Our operations include customizable design consultations, precise installation services, and ongoing maintenance for our products. We pride ourselves on adhering to strict safety protocols during the handling and transportation of heavy materials to minimize risks of damage and injury. Our team is trained in the proper installation techniques to ensure customer satisfaction and protect against installation-related claims. We source our materials from approved suppliers to maintain consistent quality and durability, and we conduct all work on-site to ensure safety and compliance with industry standards.
